evidence: The gripper moves down from the island countertop edge to the top drawer of the island drawer stack: the wrist view shows the white drawer handle right at the fingers at 22.4-24.0 s. At 25.6 s the wrist view shows the drawer front tilted and offset from the cabinet, with a dark gap and a small green object visible at its edge, so the drawer appears to be starting to come out. In the right shoulder view the gripper stays on the top handle. The drawer is at most slightly open at the last moment, and no straw has been taken. This looks like an opening in progress, but the opening amount is hard to judge.
